newsitem.title: USA: Polysindo files for $200 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Polysindo files for $200 mln in notes.

text.p: Polysindo International Finance Co B.V., a unit of P.T. Polysindo Eka Perkasa, filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $200 million in guaranteed secured notes due 2007.
The offering will be made through Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, BT Securities Corp and Merrill Lynch & Co.

Polysindo International sait it intends to lend Polysindo Eka Perkasa the proceeds from the sale of the notes. The parent intends to use such proceeds to pay a portion of the cost of Phase 1 of the New Expansion Program.
Polysindo International is based in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. The parent, based in Jakarta, is a vertically integrated polyster, chemical and textile manufacturer.
